title_en: 2027 DN Cultural Foundation Scholarship Recommendation, College of Engineering (Deadline Extended to 13 November)
summary: Undergraduate students currently enrolled who are interested in production and manufacturing and who meet the eligibility requirements may apply for recommendation to the 2027 DN Cultural Foundation Scholarship. Applicants must email all required documents by Friday, 13 November 2026, 18:00; the submission email address is in the original notice. The College of Engineering will recommend up to 15 students, and the Foundation expects to select about 5.
applies_to: Voluntary. Open to undergraduate students currently enrolled who are interested in the production and manufacturing field, with no restriction by department or school, who (1) have a grade point average of 3.3/4.3 or higher in the previous semester, (2) have two or more semesters of study remaining, and (3) have never previously been selected for this scholarship.

You must have a previous-semester GPA of 3.3/4.3 or higher and at least two semesters of study remaining.
Students who have previously been selected for this scholarship are not eligible.
If no reply is received by the deadline, it is treated as having no applicant or recommended student.

You must understand the 'Main Activities and Conditions for Maintaining Scholarship Payment' in the attached guide; these conditions are in the attachment, which was not read.

translation:
2027 College of Engineering DN Cultural Foundation Scholarship Recommendation Request (Deadline extended to Friday, 13 November)

The College of Engineering will select 2027 DN Cultural Foundation scholarship recipients as follows. Interested students should submit the required documents by email by Friday, 13 November 2026, 18:00. (Submission address: given in the original notice.)

A. Number of recommendations: No limit. ※ The College of Engineering plans to recommend up to 15 students, and the Foundation plans to select about 5.

B. Eligibility for recommendation
1) Undergraduate students currently enrolled who are interested in the production and manufacturing field. ※ No restriction by department or school.
2) Students with a grade point average of 3.3/4.3 or higher in the previous semester and with two or more semesters of study remaining.
3) Students who have not previously been selected for this scholarship.

C. Scholarship amount: Study encouragement grant of KRW 4,000,000 per year (KRW 400,000 per month x 10 months, paid March to December 2027).
※ Receiving scholarships from other organisations at the same time is allowed.

D. Selection procedure
1) Recommendation of students by each department or school (recommendation list and all submitted documents): Friday, 13 November 2026.
※ If no reply is received by the deadline, it will be treated as having no recommended student.
※ If applications exceed the College of Engineering's recommendation quota (15 students), students meeting the basic eligibility requirements will be evaluated by a combined score of grades and interest in the production and manufacturing field. In case of a tie, recipients will be determined by previous-semester GPA, then by credits completed in the previous semester.
2) College of Engineering document review and first-round selection of recommended students: during November 2026.
3) Foundation document review and selection of scholarship recipients: during December 2026.

E. Required documents: Scholarship application form (Foundation format), academic transcript (as of Spring 2026), certificate of enrollment, consent forms for collection, use and provision of personal information (Foundation and University).

F. Notes
(The notice begins this list at item 2; no item 1 appears.)
2) Students recommended by the College of Engineering may not be selected as final scholarship recipients.
3) Be familiar with the 'Main Activities and Conditions for Maintaining Scholarship Payment' in the guide.
4) The final selection results are expected to be announced in December 2026 following the Foundation's selection procedure.
5) If selected as a scholarship recipient, attendance at the award ceremony (February 2027) and the opening ceremony (시무식) (November 2027) is mandatory.

Attachments (3) — their contents were not read for this translation:
- DN문화재단 장학생 모집 안내문.docx (DN Cultural Foundation scholarship recruitment guide, 47 KB)
- DN문화재단 장학생 지원 신청서 및 동의서(양식).docx (DN Cultural Foundation scholarship application form and consent form, 58 KB)
- 개인정보 수집 이용 및 제공 동의서(공대).hwp (Consent form for collection, use and provision of personal information, College of Engineering, 79 KB)

For enquiries, contact the department office; contact details are in the original notice.
